title: fix(app-shell): hold a new state_machine / format / json_schema validation rule until it has a field and a message
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-warren"} -->
_Requested by **Warren** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ8?thread=cmsg_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ87DRAMWoEs4SFYtS1L9RwK6)_
Fixes #26731

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:Studio 校验规则面板里,新建的 状态机 / 格式 / JSON schema 规则不再立刻写进对象草稿,而是先留在面板里,直到选了字段并填了错误消息才写入一次;「Add transition」的空行在填起始状态前不落盘;条件规则(conditional)的 `when` 换成自己的说明文字(中英文)。
- 为什么改:原来一点「新建」就把规则存到对象的第一个字段(实测会是 `created_at`)上、消息为空,空转换行以 `"": []` 存进去并会被发布;条件规则的说明写成「失败条件,为真时拒绝保存」,与 `when` 的真实含义相反。
- 风险与回滚:只改面板的新建流程与文案,已有规则的编辑与切换类型行为不变,不改 spec;回滚即 revert 本 PR。已知代价同 objectui#11820:未补全就离开页面,这条新规则会丢弃(界面已标「未保存」)。
- 先看:`ObjectValidationsPanel.tsx` 的 `missingPart` 与 `makeSkeleton`(新规则不再预填字段);同文件 `TransitionsField` 的空行;`ObjectValidationsPanel.newRuleComplete-26731.test.tsx`。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/ObjectValidationsPanel`,预期 11 个文件 113 条全绿。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

- **A new field rule is held until it is complete.** `state_machine`, `format` and `json_schema` now take the same in-panel hold guarded rules got in objectui#11820. A new one starts with no field (the `pickField` placeholder), is listed and marked not saved, and is written to the draft once, when it has a field and a non-blank message. `missingPart` wraps the unchanged `missingGuard`; the held line and the list mark name what is missing (`engine.studio.held.needsRuleField` / `needsRuleMessage`, `engine.studio.rules.notSavedField` / `notSavedMessage`), and the hold's input hint sits under the field picker or the message input.
- **An empty transition row is not stored.** "Add transition" opens a blank row kept in `TransitionsField` state; it is written when it gets a from-state. The blank row renders at the index its written row takes, so typing its first letter keeps focus.
- **The conditional caption.** A `conditional` rule's `when` group now reads "Guard (CEL) — when the condition is **true**, the “Then” rule below applies; otherwise the “Otherwise” rule, if one is set." (`engine.studio.rules.whenPre` / `whenMid`, en and zh). Script and cross-field keep the fail-condition caption.
- Unchanged by design: an EXISTING rule's editing and its type switch (still the valid `'false'` placeholder and the first field), presets, and the spec.

## Why

Triage first grade on the card: a new state_machine / format / json_schema validation saved immediately as a live rule on `created_at` with an empty message, and the conditional rule's wording inverted `when`. On base `f79ec289`, `makeSkeleton` seeded those three types with `firstField` (the first non-hidden field; a `system` audit column is not skipped, so a served object yields `created_at`) and `message: ''`, and `placeNewRule` wrote any guard-less rule at once.

## Tests

- New `ObjectValidationsPanel.newRuleComplete-26731.test.tsx` (10 tests): per type, held with no field, then field, then message → written once and parses through `ValidationRuleSchema`; message-first order; blank message does not complete; control that an existing rule's type switch still seeds the first field; blank transition row writes nothing until it has a from-state, and deleting it writes nothing; the conditional caption differs from the script caption in en and zh.
- Existing tests updated only where the hold changes what they read: the newRuleWaits-11820 control ("a type with no guard is written at once") now fills field and message first, and `ObjectValidationsPanel.test.tsx`, `whenKey`, `runsOn-11923` pick a field and type a message before reading the written rule. presets-11861 is untouched and green. `StudioEmptyState.panels-12514.test.tsx` ("a pick from it writes the rule the header's pick writes") now picks the field and types the message after picking Format from the empty block, then expects exactly one write (`c6be0644`).
- `ResourceEditPage.environmentOverlay-12141.test.tsx` gains a module-scope `await loadStudioCatalogue('zh')`: its lock banner's zh row lives in the lazy `studio` namespace since #26815 (#25922 S3), and without the preload the zh-CN banner case is red on every run (seat Claim widened 6451337559). Red without it (1 failed / 11 passed), green with it (12/12).
- Ablation: `missingPart`'s field-type branch replaced with `if (false) {` through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` → 5 of 10 new tests red (all three per-type tests, message-first, blank message); restored, blob equal to HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty.

## Acceptance notes

- Same known cost as objectui#11820: a held new rule is dropped if the author leaves the Rules view or the object before completing it, and Publish does not wait for it.
- A legacy stored `"": []` transitions key is still shown as a row (and keeps "Add transition" disabled) — this PR stops writing it, it does not rewrite stored rules.

## Verification

Head `5e35145d` (origin/main `a20824f3`, with #26859, merged in): affected set 14 files / 156 tests green; 24/24 derived gates exit 0, `--ran` 0 NOT-MEASURED; PR CI 42 success · 10 skipped · 0 failure.

<details><summary>Local runs at head 6643455e (origin/main aeb9cf0d merged)</summary>

- `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/ObjectValidationsPanel` — Test Files 11 passed (11), Tests 113 passed (113); lock VERDICT command-exit 0.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell run type-check` — VERDICT command-exit 0.
- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` — 24 families, each exit 0; `--ran` reconciliation: 24 derived, 24 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN. Also run outside the derivation, exit 0: `pnpm --dir ui run check:new-line-citations`, `pnpm check:i18n-stale-fill`.
- No changeset: `@object-ui/app-shell` is `private: true` (label `skip-changeset`).

</details>
